other: Term paper may not exceed 20 pages double-spaced, not counting the bibliography.
Graduate students pick one of four term-paper options (case study, named heritage site, living-site critique, or a journal survey).
The heritage management paper is done as a team of 2-3 students and handed in as one paper.
